skill.name: startup-metrics-framework
skill.description: Guides startup teams through core SaaS, marketplace, consumer, and B2B metrics from pre-seed through Series A.
skill.summary: Build a focused startup metrics framework with formulas, benchmarks, and tracking guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Startup teams often track too many metrics or miss the numbers investors expect. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code build focused metrics plans with formulas, benchmarks, and review cadences.
actual_capabilities: Explains core revenue, retention, unit economics, and cash efficiency formulas.
Maps metric priorities to pre-seed, seed, and Series A company stages.
Provides benchmark ranges for SaaS, marketplace, consumer, mobile, and B2B models.
Suggests reporting cadences for daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews.
Outlines investor-facing metrics for seed, Series A, and later funding rounds.
limitations: Does not connect to analytics platforms or calculate metrics from live company data.
Benchmarks are general guidance and may not fit every market or pricing model.
Does not replace financial, accounting, or fundraising advice from qualified professionals.
Referenced examples and reference files are mentioned but not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Design a Seed Metrics Dashboard
use_cases.description: Choose the right 5 to 7 metrics for a seed-stage SaaS company and define review cadence.

use_cases.title: Prepare Investor Metrics
use_cases.description: Translate current performance into ARR, CAC payback, retention, burn multiple, and runway talking points.

use_cases.title: Benchmark Growth Efficiency
use_cases.description: Compare SaaS, marketplace, or B2B metrics against common ranges and identify weak operating areas.

prompt_templates.title: Pick Core Metrics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple starter framework.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose 5 core startup metrics for a [business model] company at [stage]. Include formulas, targets, and review cadence.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Unit Economics
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using known acquisition and revenue inputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our CAC, LTV, gross margin, churn, ARPU, and payback period. Explain which metrics are healthy and which need attention.

prompt_templates.title: Build Investor Update Metrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an investor metrics section for our [round] update using MRR, ARR growth, retention, burn, runway, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Growth Efficiency
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced operating review across multiple metric categories.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our startup metrics by stage and business model. Identify missing metrics, weak benchmarks, and the next dashboard changes to make.

output_examples.input: We are a seed-stage SaaS company with early MRR. What should we track weekly?
output: Weekly focus: MRR growth, net new MRR, logo retention, active product usage, CAC trend, and runway.
Add monthly review for LTV:CAC, CAC payback, gross retention, and burn multiple.
Use targets such as 15 to 20 percent monthly growth, gross retention above 85 percent, and payback under 18 months.

output_examples.input: Our marketplace has high demand but slow transactions. Which metrics matter?
output: Track GMV growth, take rate, fill rate, time to transaction, repeat rate, and supply-demand balance.
Slow transactions suggest a liquidity issue, so segment fill rate by category, geography, and supplier type.
Review whether demand is outpacing supply and set weekly targets for active supply growth.

output_examples.input: Help us prepare Series A metric talking points.
output: Lead with ARR, year-over-year growth, CAC payback, LTV:CAC, net dollar retention, burn multiple, and runway.
Show current value, trend, and benchmark for each metric.
Highlight efficient growth if payback is below 18 months, LTV:CAC is above 3, and burn multiple is below 2.

best_practices: Start with business model, company stage, and decision needs before selecting metrics.
Track a small set of actionable metrics deeply instead of many vanity metrics.
Pair each metric with a formula, owner, review cadence, and benchmark target.
anti_patterns: Using total users, downloads, or page views without retention or activation context.
Comparing metrics to generic benchmarks without segmenting by channel, cohort, or customer type.
Optimizing dashboard numbers while ignoring cash efficiency, retention, and unit economics.

faq.question: Which business models does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers SaaS, marketplace, consumer, mobile, and B2B startup metrics.

faq.question: Can it calculate metrics from my database?
faq.answer: No. It explains formulas and frameworks, but it does not connect to live data sources.

faq.question: Is this only for fundraising?
faq.answer: No. It supports fundraising, operating reviews, dashboard design, and metric prioritization.

faq.question: What stages does it support?
faq.answer: It gives guidance for pre-seed, seed, Series A, and later growth stages.

faq.question: Does it include benchmarks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes common target ranges for retention, growth, CAC payback, burn multiple, and related metrics.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it to build a dashboard?
faq.answer: It can guide metric selection and formulas, but implementation depends on the user's data stack and application code.
